title: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.06254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The performance of large language model (LLM) agents depends on both the underlying model and the harness that governs interaction with tools and the environment. Yet harness design remains largely manual, and automating it requires navigating an open-ended search space through costly end-to-end evaluations. We introduce HarnessFlow, a framework for optimizing complete executable harnesses under a limited candidate-evaluation budget, with the model and task environment held fixed. HarnessFlow organizes candidates and their evaluation histories in a refinement tree, using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based policy to balance exploitation and exploration. A coding agent refines selected harnesses using archived code, execution feedback, and a library of reusable harness mechanisms. translated_title: HarnessFlow：面向大语言模型智能体的MCTS引导式执行框架优化方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体的性能既取决于底层模型，也取决于控制其与工具和环境交互的执行框架。然而，框架设计在很大程度上仍依赖人工完成，而实现自动化则需要通过代价高昂的端到端评估在一个开放式的搜索空间中进行探索。我们提出了HarnessFlow，这是一个在候选评估预算有限、且模型与任务环境保持固定的条件下，对完整可执行框架进行优化的框架。HarnessFlow将候选方案及其评估历史组织在一棵精细化改进树中，并采用基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的策略来平衡利用与探索。一个编码智能体则利用归档代码、执行反馈以及可复用框架机制库，对被选中的框架进行迭代改进。在每个基准测试仅需15次精细化尝试的条件下，HarnessFlow在涵盖智能体任务的六个基准测试中，于所有对比方法中取得了最高的平均测试分数。
tldr: HarnessFlow通过MCTS引导的精细化改进树搜索与编码智能体，在有限评估预算下自动优化LLM智能体的完整可执行执行框架，在六个基准测试中取得最高平均测试分数。
en_tdlr: HarnessFlow leverages MCTS-guided refinement tree search and a coding agent to automatically optimize complete executable harnesses for LLM agents under a limited evaluation budget, achieving the highest mean scores across six benchmarks.
